sentences.zh: 推月食法

translations.literal: Method for computing lunar eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for computing lunar eclipses

sentences.zh: 求天正冬至，同日躔。

translations.literal: To find the civil-year winter solstice, same as solar motion section.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the civil year, use the same method as in the section on solar motion.

sentences.zh: 求紀日，以天正冬至日數加一日，得紀日。

translations.literal: To find cycle days: add one day to the civil-year winter solstice day-count, obtaining cycle days.
translations.idiomatic: To find the cycle-day count, add one day to the winter-solstice day-number of the civil year.

sentences.zh: 求首朔，先求得積日同月離。

translations.literal: To find the epoch new moon, first obtain accumulated days as in lunar distance section.
translations.idiomatic: To find the epoch new moon, first compute the accumulated days by the same method as in the lunar-distance section.

sentences.zh: 置積日減朔應，得通朔。

translations.literal: Set accumulated days, subtract new-moon offset, obtaining general new-moon interval.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the new-moon epoch offset from the accumulated days to obtain the general new-moon interval.

sentences.zh: 上考則加。

translations.literal: For backward projection, add instead.
translations.idiomatic: When projecting backward into antiquity, add instead of subtract.

sentences.zh: 以朔策除之，得數加一為積朔。

translations.literal: Divide by new-moon interval, add one to the quotient for accumulated new moons.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the new-moon interval constant; add one to the quotient to obtain the count of accumulated new moons.

sentences.zh: 餘數轉減朔策為首朔。

translations.literal: Remainder, reverse-subtract from new-moon interval, for epoch new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the remainder from the new-moon interval constant to obtain the epoch new-moon fraction.

sentences.zh: 上考則除得之數即積朔，不用加一。

translations.literal: For backward projection, quotient itself is accumulated new moons, no adding one.
translations.idiomatic: For backward projection, the quotient itself is the accumulated new-moon count; do not add one.

sentences.zh: 餘數即首朔，不用轉減。

translations.literal: Remainder itself is epoch new moon, no reverse subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder itself is the epoch new-moon fraction; no reverse subtraction is needed.

sentences.zh: 求太陰入食限，置積朔，以太陰交周朔策乘之，滿周天秒數去之，餘為積朔太陰交周。

translations.literal: To find moon entering eclipse limit: set accumulated new moons, multiply by moon nodal new-moon interval, remove full circuit seconds, remainder is accumulated-new-moon moon nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: To determine whether the moon enters the eclipse zone: multiply the accumulated new-moon count by the nodal motion per synodic month, cast out full circuits of the celestial seconds, and the remainder is the nodal longitude at accumulated new moon.

sentences.zh: 加首朔太陰交周應，得首朔太陰交周。

translations.literal: Add epoch new-moon moon nodal offset, obtaining epoch new-moon moon nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Add the epoch nodal longitude at new moon to obtain the nodal longitude at the first new moon.

sentences.zh: 上考則置首朔交周應減積朔交周。

translations.literal: For backward projection, set epoch nodal offset minus accumulated-new-moon nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: For backward projection, subtract the accumulated nodal longitude from the epoch nodal offset instead.

sentences.zh: 又加太陰交周望策，再以交周朔策遞加十三次，得逐月望太陰平交周。

translations.literal: Further add moon nodal full-moon interval, then successively add nodal new-moon interval thirteen times, obtaining each month's full-moon mean nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Add the nodal motion per half-month, then add the nodal motion per synodic month thirteen times in succession to obtain the mean nodal longitude at each month's full moon.

sentences.zh: 視某月交周入可食之限，即為有食之月。

translations.literal: If a given month's nodal longitude enters the possible-eclipse limit, that month may have an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If a given month's nodal longitude falls within the possible-eclipse zone, that month may witness a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交周自五宮十五度０六分至六宮十四度五十四分，自十一宮十五度０六分至初宮十四度五十四分，皆可食之限。

translations.literal: Nodal longitude from fifth mansion 15°06′ to sixth mansion 14°54′, and from eleventh mansion 15°06′ to first mansion 14°54′, are all possible-eclipse limits.
translations.idiomatic: The possible-eclipse zone runs from 15°06′ in the fifth mansion to 14°54′ in the sixth, and from 15°06′ in the eleventh mansion to 14°54′ in the first.

sentences.zh: 再於實交周詳之。

translations.literal: Examine further with true nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Refine the result using the true nodal longitude.

sentences.zh: 求平望，以太陰入食限月數與朔策相乘，加望策，再加首朔日分及紀日，滿紀法去之，餘為平望日分。

translations.literal: To find mean full moon: multiply month-count of moon in eclipse limit by new-moon interval, add full-moon interval, further add epoch new-moon day-fraction and cycle days, remove full cycle divisor, remainder is mean full-moon day-fraction.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean full moon: multiply the eclipse-month index by the new-moon interval, add the half-month interval, then add the epoch new-moon day-fraction and cycle-day count; cast out full cycle periods, and the remainder is the mean full-moon day-fraction.

sentences.zh: 自初日起甲子，得平望干支，以刻下分通其小餘，如法收之。

translations.literal: From first day count sexagenary day, obtaining mean full-moon stem-branch; convert fractional remainder via sub-quarter parts, reduce by rule.
translations.idiomatic: Count the sexagenary day from the epoch jiazi day to obtain the mean full-moon day stem-branch; convert the fractional remainder through sub-quarter parts and reduce by the standard rule.

sentences.zh: 初時起子正，得時刻分秒。

translations.literal: From initial time starting at exact zi, obtain hour, quarter, minute, second.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from exact zi as the initial hour, obtain the hour, quarter, minute, and second.

sentences.zh: 求太陽平行，置積朔，加太陰入食限之月數為通月，以太陽平行朔策乘之。

translations.literal: To find sun mean motion: set accumulated new moons, add moon eclipse-limit month-count as general month-count, multiply by sun mean-motion new-moon interval.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's mean longitude: take the accumulated new-moon count, add the eclipse-month index to obtain the general month-count, and multiply by the sun's mean motion per synodic month.

sentences.zh: 滿周天秒數去之，加首朔太陽平行應，上考則減。

translations.literal: Remove full circuit seconds, add epoch new-moon sun mean-motion offset; for backward projection, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full circuits of celestial seconds, add the epoch sun mean longitude at new moon; for backward projection, subtract instead.

sentences.zh: 又加太陽平行望策，即得。

translations.literal: Further add sun mean-motion full-moon interval, and it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Add the sun's mean motion per half-month to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 求太陽平引，置通月，以太陽引數朔策乘之，去周天秒數，加首朔太陽引數應，上考則減。

translations.literal: To find sun mean anomaly: set general month-count, multiply by sun anomaly new-moon interval, remove circuit seconds, add epoch sun anomaly offset; backward projection subtracts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's mean equation: multiply the general month-count by the sun's equation per synodic month, cast out full circuits, and add the epoch sun equation; for backward projection, subtract.

sentences.zh: 又加太陽引數望策，即得。

translations.literal: Further add sun anomaly full-moon interval, and it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Add the sun's equation per half-month to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 求太陰平引，置通月，以太陰引數朔策乘之，去周天秒數，加首朔太陰引數應，上考則減。

translations.literal: To find moon mean anomaly: set general month-count, multiply by moon anomaly new-moon interval, remove circuit seconds, add epoch moon anomaly offset; backward projection subtracts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's mean anomaly: multiply the general month-count by the moon's anomaly per synodic month, cast out full circuits, and add the epoch moon anomaly; for backward projection, subtract.

sentences.zh: 又加太陰引數望策，即得。

translations.literal: Further add moon anomaly full-moon interval, and it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Add the moon's anomaly per half-month to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 求太陰實引，以一小時化秒為一率，太陰一小時引數為二率，距時秒為三率，求得四率為秒。

translations.literal: To find moon true anomaly: one hour in seconds as first ratio, moon hourly anomaly as second, interval-time in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's true anomaly: use one hour converted to seconds as the first ratio, the moon's hourly anomaly as the second, and the interval time in seconds as the third; the fourth ratio gives the correction in seconds.

sentences.zh: 以度分收之，為太陰引弧。

translations.literal: Reduce to degrees and minutes, as moon anomaly arc.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to degrees and minutes to obtain the moon's anomaly arc.

sentences.zh: 依距時加減號。

translations.literal: Follow interval-time sign for addition or subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: Apply addition or subtraction according to the sign of the interval time.

sentences.zh: 以加減太陰平引，得實引。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from moon mean anomaly, obtaining true anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this from the moon's mean anomaly to obtain the true anomaly.

sentences.zh: 求實望，以太陽實引復求均數為日實均，並求得太陽距地心線。

translations.literal: To find true full moon: from sun true anomaly again find equation as sun true equation, and also obtain sun geocentric distance line.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true full moon: from the sun's true anomaly compute the equation of center as the sun's true equation, and also obtain the sun's geocentric distance.

sentences.zh: 即實均第二平三角形對正角之邊。

translations.literal: That is, the side opposite the right angle in the second plane triangle of the true equation.
translations.idiomatic: This is the side opposite the right angle in the second plane triangle of the true equation.

sentences.zh: 以太陰實引復求均數為月實均，并求得太陰距地心線。

translations.literal: From moon true anomaly again find equation as moon true equation, and also obtain moon geocentric distance line.
translations.idiomatic: From the moon's true anomaly compute the equation of center as the moon's true equation, and also obtain the moon's geocentric distance.

sentences.zh: 法同太陽。

translations.literal: Method same as for sun.
translations.idiomatic: The method is the same as for the sun.

sentences.zh: 兩均相加減為實距弧。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the two equations for true elongation arc.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the two equations to obtain the true elongation arc.

sentences.zh: 加減與距弧同。

translations.literal: Addition or subtraction follows the elongation arc.
translations.idiomatic: The sign of addition or subtraction follows that of the elongation arc.

sentences.zh: 依前求距時法，求得時分為實距時，以加減平望，加減與距時同。

translations.literal: By previous method for interval time, obtain hours and minutes as true-interval time, add or subtract from mean full moon; sign same as interval time.
translations.idiomatic: By the previous method for interval time, convert to hours and minutes as the true interval time, and add or subtract from the mean full moon with the same sign.

sentences.zh: 得實望。

translations.literal: Obtain true full moon.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the true full moon.

sentences.zh: 加滿二十四時，則實望進一日，不足減者，借一日作二十四時減之，則實望退一日。

translations.literal: If addition fills twenty-four hours, true full moon advances one day; if insufficient to subtract, borrow one day as twenty-four hours to subtract, true full moon retreats one day.
translations.idiomatic: If the addition reaches twenty-four hours, the true full moon advances one day; if subtraction is insufficient, borrow one day as twenty-four hours, and the true full moon retreats one day.

sentences.zh: 求實交周，以一小時化秒為一率，太陰一小時交周為二率，實距時化秒為三率，求得四率為秒，以度分收之，為交周距弧。

translations.literal: To find true nodal longitude: one hour in seconds as first ratio, moon hourly nodal motion as second, true interval time in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds, reduce to degrees and minutes as nodal interval arc.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true nodal longitude: use one hour in seconds, the moon's hourly nodal motion, and the true interval time in seconds; convert the result to degrees and minutes as the nodal interval arc.

sentences.zh: 以加減太陰交周，依實距時加減號。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from moon nodal longitude, following true-interval-time sign.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract from the moon's nodal longitude according to the sign of the true interval time.

sentences.zh: 又以月實均加減之，為實交周。

translations.literal: Further add or subtract moon true equation, as true nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Further add or subtract the moon's true equation to obtain the true nodal longitude.

sentences.zh: 若實交周入必食之限，為有食。

translations.literal: If true nodal longitude enters certain-eclipse limit, there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If the true nodal longitude falls within the certain-eclipse zone, an eclipse will occur.

sentences.zh: 自五宮十七度四十三分０五秒至六宮十二度十六分五十五秒，自十一宮十七度四十三分０五秒至初宮十二度十六分五十五秒，為必食之限。

translations.literal: From fifth mansion 17°43′05″ to sixth mansion 12°16′55″, and from eleventh mansion 17°43′05″ to first mansion 12°16′55″, are certain-eclipse limits.
translations.idiomatic: The certain-eclipse zone runs from 17°43′05″ in the fifth mansion to 12°16′55″ in the sixth, and from 17°43′05″ in the eleventh mansion to 12°16′55″ in the first.

sentences.zh: 不入此限者，不必布算。

translations.literal: If not entering this limit, need not deploy calculation.
translations.idiomatic: If the longitude does not fall within this zone, no further calculation is required.

sentences.zh: 求太陽黃赤道實經度，以一小時化秒為一率，太陽一小時平行為二率，實距時化秒為三率，求得四率為秒，以度分收之，為太陽距弧。

translations.literal: To find sun true ecliptic and equatorial longitude: one hour in seconds as first ratio, sun hourly mean motion as second, true interval time in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds, reduce to degrees and minutes as sun interval arc.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's true ecliptic and equatorial longitude: use one hour in seconds, the sun's hourly mean motion, and the true interval time; convert to degrees and minutes as the solar interval arc.

sentences.zh: 依時距時加減號。

translations.literal: Follow interval-time sign for addition or subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: Apply addition or subtraction according to the sign of the interval time.

sentences.zh: 以加減太陽平行，又以日實均加減之，即黃道經度。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from sun mean motion, further add or subtract sun true equation, obtaining ecliptic longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract from the sun's mean longitude and further apply the sun's true equation to obtain the ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 又用弧三角形求得赤道經度。

translations.literal: Also use spherical triangle to obtain equatorial longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Use a spherical triangle to obtain the equatorial longitude as well.

sentences.zh: 詳月離求太陰出入時刻條。

translations.literal: See lunar distance section on finding moon rise and set times.
translations.idiomatic: See the section on lunar distance for the method of finding the moon's rising and setting times.

sentences.zh: 求實望用時，以日實均變時為均數時差，以升度差黃赤道經度之較。

translations.literal: To find true full-moon apparent time: convert sun true equation to time as equation time difference; rising-degree difference is comparison of ecliptic and equatorial longitudes.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent time of true full moon: convert the sun's true equation to time as the equation time correction; the rising-degree correction is the difference between ecliptic and equatorial longitudes.

sentences.zh: 變時為升度時差，兩時差相加減為時差總，加減之法，詳月離求用時平行條。

translations.literal: Convert to time as rising-degree time difference; add or subtract the two time differences for total time difference; addition-subtraction method, see lunar distance section on apparent-time mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the rising-degree difference to time; combine the two time corrections; for the rules of addition and subtraction, see the section on lunar distance concerning apparent time and mean motion.

sentences.zh: 以加減實望，為實望用時。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from true full moon, obtaining true full-moon apparent time.
translations.idiomatic: Apply these corrections to the true full moon to obtain the apparent time of true full moon.

sentences.zh: 距日出後日入前九刻以內者，可以見食。

translations.literal: Within nine quarters after sunrise or before sunset, eclipse can be seen.
translations.idiomatic: An eclipse can be observed if it falls within nine quarters of an hour after sunrise or before sunset.

sentences.zh: 九刻以外者全在晝，不必算。

translations.literal: Beyond nine quarters, entirely in daytime, need not calculate.
translations.idiomatic: If it lies beyond nine quarters, the event falls entirely in daylight and need not be calculated.

sentences.zh: 求食甚時刻，以本天半徑為一率，黃白大距之餘弦為二率，實交周之正切為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得食甚交周。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse time: celestial radius as first ratio, cosine of great ecliptic-lunar distance as second, tangent of true nodal longitude as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for greatest-eclipse nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: To find the time of greatest eclipse: use the celestial radius as the first ratio, the cosine of the great ecliptic-lunar distance as the second, and the tangent of the true nodal longitude as the third; look up the resulting tangent in the tables to obtain the nodal longitude at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 與實交周相減，為交周升度差。

translations.literal: Subtract from true nodal longitude, as nodal rising-degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the true nodal longitude to obtain the nodal rising-degree difference.

sentences.zh: 又以太陰一小時引數與太陰實引相加，依月離求初均法算之，為後均。

translations.literal: Further add moon hourly anomaly to moon true anomaly, compute by lunar-distance first-equation method, as second equation.
translations.idiomatic: Add the moon's hourly anomaly to its true anomaly and compute by the first-equation method in the lunar-distance section to obtain the second equation.

sentences.zh: 以後均與月實均相加減，兩均同號相減，異號相加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract second equation with moon true equation; same sign subtract, opposite sign add.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the second equation with the moon's true equation: subtract if they share the same sign, add if opposite.

sentences.zh: 得數又與一小時月距日平行相加減，兩均同加，後均大則加，小則減。

translations.literal: Result further add or subtract with hourly moon-sun mean elongation; both equations both add, if second equation larger then add, smaller then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Combine this result with the hourly mean moon-sun elongation: if both equations call for addition, add the larger second equation and subtract the smaller; if both call for subtraction, subtract the larger and add the smaller.

sentences.zh: 兩均同減，後均大則減，小則加。

translations.literal: Both equations both subtract, second equation larger then subtract, smaller then add.
translations.idiomatic: If both equations call for subtraction, subtract the larger second equation and add the smaller.

sentences.zh: 兩均一加一減，其加減從後均。

translations.literal: One equation add, one subtract, addition-subtraction follows second equation.
translations.idiomatic: If one equation calls for addition and the other for subtraction, follow the sign of the second equation.

sentences.zh: 為月距日實行。

translations.literal: This is moon-sun true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the moon's true elongation from the sun.

sentences.zh: 乃以月距日實行化秒為一率，一小時化秒為二率，交周升度差化秒為三率，求得四率為秒。

translations.literal: Then moon-sun true motion in seconds as first ratio, one hour in seconds as second, nodal rising-degree difference in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Use the true moon-sun elongation in seconds as the first ratio, one hour in seconds as the second, and the nodal rising-degree difference in seconds as the third; the fourth ratio gives the correction in seconds.

sentences.zh: 以時分收之，得食甚距時。

translations.literal: Reduce to hours and minutes, obtaining greatest-eclipse interval time.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to hours and minutes to obtain the interval time to greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以加減實望用時，實交周初宮六宮為減，五宮十一宮為加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from true full-moon apparent time; true nodal longitude in first or sixth mansion subtract, fifth or eleventh mansion add.
translations.idiomatic: Apply this to the apparent time of true full moon: subtract if the true nodal longitude is in the first or sixth mansion, add if in the fifth or eleventh.

sentences.zh: 為食甚時刻。

translations.literal: This is greatest-eclipse time.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the time of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求食甚距緯，以本天半徑為一率，黃白大距之正弦為二率，實交周之正弦為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得食甚距緯。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse latitude distance: celestial radius as first ratio, sine of great ecliptic-lunar distance as second, sine of true nodal longitude as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for greatest-eclipse latitude distance.
translations.idiomatic: To find the latitude distance at greatest eclipse: use the celestial radius, the sine of the great ecliptic-lunar distance, and the sine of the true nodal longitude; look up the resulting sine in the tables.

sentences.zh: 實交周初宮五宮為北，六宮十一宮為南。

translations.literal: True nodal longitude in first or fifth mansion is north, sixth or eleventh mansion is south.
translations.idiomatic: If the true nodal longitude is in the first or fifth mansion, the latitude is north; if in the sixth or eleventh, south.

sentences.zh: 求太陰半徑，以太陰最高距地為一率，地半徑比例數為二率，太陰距地心線內減去次均輪半徑為三率，求得四率為太陰距地。

translations.literal: To find moon semidiameter: moon apogee distance as first ratio, Earth-semidiameter ratio number as second, moon geocentric line minus deferent epicycle radius as third, fourth ratio is moon distance from Earth.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar semidiameter: use the lunar apogee distance as the first ratio, the Earth-semidiameter ratio as the second, and the moon's geocentric distance minus the deferent epicycle radius as the third; the fourth ratio gives the moon's distance from Earth.

sentences.zh: 又以太陰距地為一率，太陰實半徑為二率，本天半徑為三率，求得四率為正弦。

translations.literal: Further, moon distance from Earth as first ratio, moon true semidiameter as second, celestial radius as third, fourth ratio is sine.
translations.idiomatic: Further use the moon's distance from Earth as the first ratio, its true semidiameter as the second, and the celestial radius as the third; the fourth ratio is a sine.

sentences.zh: 檢表得太陰半徑。

translations.literal: Look up table to obtain moon semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: Look up the result in the tables to obtain the lunar semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 求地影半徑，以太陽最高距地為一率，地半徑比例數為二率，太陽距地心線為三率，求得四率為太陽距地。

translations.literal: To find Earth-shadow semidiameter: sun apogee distance as first ratio, Earth-semidiameter ratio as second, sun geocentric line as third, fourth ratio is sun distance from Earth.
translations.idiomatic: To find the Earth's shadow semidiameter: use the solar apogee distance, the Earth-semidiameter ratio, and the sun's geocentric distance; the fourth ratio gives the sun's distance from Earth.

sentences.zh: 又以太陽光分半徑內減地半徑為一率，太陽距地為二率，地半徑為三率，求得四率為地影之長。

translations.literal: Further, sun light-semidiameter minus Earth semidiameter as first ratio, sun distance from Earth as second, Earth semidiameter as third, fourth ratio is Earth-shadow length.
translations.idiomatic: Use the solar light-semidiameter minus the Earth's semidiameter as the first ratio, the sun's distance as the second, and the Earth's semidiameter as the third; the fourth ratio gives the length of the Earth's shadow.

sentences.zh: 又以地影長為一率，地半徑為二率，本天半徑為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得地影角。

translations.literal: Further, Earth-shadow length as first ratio, Earth semidiameter as second, celestial radius as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for Earth-shadow angle.
translations.idiomatic: Use the shadow length, Earth's semidiameter, and celestial radius; look up the resulting sine in the tables to obtain the Earth-shadow angle.

sentences.zh: 又以本天半徑為一率，地影角之正切為二率，地影長內減太陰距地為三率，求得四率為太陰所入地影之闊。

translations.literal: Further, celestial radius as first ratio, tangent of Earth-shadow angle as second, shadow length minus moon distance as third, fourth ratio is width of shadow entered by moon.
translations.idiomatic: Use the celestial radius, the tangent of the shadow angle, and the shadow length minus the moon's distance; the fourth ratio gives the width of shadow entered by the moon.

sentences.zh: 乃以太陰距地為一率，地影之闊為二率，本天半徑為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得地影半徑。

translations.literal: Then moon distance as first ratio, shadow width as second, celestial radius as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for Earth-shadow semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: Use the moon's distance, the shadow width, and the celestial radius; look up the resulting tangent to obtain the Earth's shadow semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 求食分，以太陰全徑為一率，十分為二率，並徑太陰地影兩半徑相併。

translations.literal: To find eclipse magnitude: moon full diameter as first ratio, ten as second ratio, combined diameter of moon and Earth-shadow semidiameters joined.
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse magnitude: use the moon's full diameter as the first ratio and ten as the second; the third ratio is the sum of the lunar and Earth-shadow semidiameters.

sentences.zh: 內減食甚距緯之較並徑不及減距緯即不食。

translations.literal: Subtract inward the comparison of greatest-eclipse latitude distance; if combined diameter insufficient to subtract latitude distance, then no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the latitude distance at greatest eclipse; if the combined diameter cannot cover the latitude separation, no eclipse occurs.

sentences.zh: 為三率，求得四率即食分。

translations.literal: As third ratio, fourth ratio obtained is eclipse magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: This serves as the third ratio; the fourth ratio is the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓時刻，以食甚距緯之餘弦為一率，並徑之餘弦為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率為餘弦，檢表得初虧、復圓距弧。

translations.literal: To find first-contact and last-contact times: cosine of greatest-eclipse latitude distance as first ratio, cosine of combined diameter as second, radius ten million as third, fourth ratio is cosine, look up table for first-contact and last-contact interval arcs.
translations.idiomatic: To find the times of first and last contact: use the cosine of the latitude at greatest eclipse, the cosine of the combined diameter, and the radius of ten million; look up the arc intervals in the tables.

sentences.zh: 又以月距日實行化秒為一率，一小時化秒為二率，初虧、復圓距弧化秒為三率，求得四率為秒。

translations.literal: Further, moon-sun true motion in seconds as first ratio, one hour in seconds as second, first-contact and last-contact interval arcs in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Use the true moon-sun elongation in seconds, one hour in seconds, and the contact interval arcs in seconds; the fourth ratio gives the correction in seconds.

sentences.zh: 以時分收之，為初虧、復圓距時。

translations.literal: Reduce to hours and minutes, as first-contact and last-contact interval times.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to hours and minutes to obtain the interval times to first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 以加減食甚時刻，得初虧、復圓時刻。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from greatest-eclipse time, obtaining first-contact and last-contact times.
translations.idiomatic: Apply these to the time of greatest eclipse to obtain the times of first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 減得初虧，加得復圓。

translations.literal: Subtract to obtain first contact, add to obtain last contact.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for first contact; add for last contact.

sentences.zh: 求食既、生光時刻，以食甚距緯之餘弦為一率，兩半徑較之餘弦為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率為餘弦，檢表得食既、生光距弧。

translations.literal: To find totality-beginning and light-return times: cosine of greatest-eclipse latitude as first ratio, cosine of two-semidiameter difference as second, radius ten million as third, fourth ratio is cosine, look up table for totality and light-return interval arcs.
translations.idiomatic: To find the times when totality begins and light returns: use the cosine of the latitude at greatest eclipse, the cosine of the difference of the two semidiameters, and the radius of ten million; look up the arc intervals in the tables.

sentences.zh: 又以月距日實行化秒為一率，一小時化秒為二率，食既、生光距弧化秒為三率，求得四率為秒。

translations.literal: Further, moon-sun true motion in seconds as first ratio, one hour in seconds as second, totality and light-return arcs in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Use the true moon-sun elongation in seconds, one hour in seconds, and the totality interval arcs in seconds; the fourth ratio gives the correction in seconds.

sentences.zh: 以時分收之，為食既、生光距時。

translations.literal: Reduce to hours and minutes, as totality and light-return interval times.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to hours and minutes to obtain the interval times to totality and light return.

sentences.zh: 以加減食甚時刻，得食既、生光時刻。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from greatest-eclipse time, obtaining totality and light-return times.
translations.idiomatic: Apply these to the time of greatest eclipse to obtain the times of totality and light return.

sentences.zh: 減得食既，加得生光。

translations.literal: Subtract to obtain totality beginning, add to obtain light return.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for the beginning of totality; add for the return of light.

sentences.zh: 求食限總時，以初虧、復圓距時倍之，即得。

translations.literal: To find total eclipse duration: double the first-contact and last-contact interval time, and it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the total duration of the eclipse, double the interval time from greatest eclipse to first or last contact.

sentences.zh: 求太陰黃道經緯度，置太陽黃道經度，加減六宮，過六宮則減去六宮，不及六宮，則加六宮。

translations.literal: To find moon ecliptic longitude and latitude: set sun ecliptic longitude, add or subtract six mansions; if exceeding six mansions subtract six, if insufficient add six.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's ecliptic longitude and latitude: take the sun's ecliptic longitude and add or subtract six mansions; if the result exceeds six mansions, subtract six; if insufficient, add six.

sentences.zh: 再加減食甚距弧，又加減黃白升度差，求升度差法，詳月離求黃道實行條。

translations.literal: Further add or subtract greatest-eclipse interval arc, further add or subtract ecliptic-lunar rising-degree difference; method for rising-degree difference, see lunar distance section on true ecliptic motion.
translations.idiomatic: Further add or subtract the interval arc at greatest eclipse and the ecliptic-lunar rising-degree difference; for the method of finding the rising-degree difference, see the lunar-distance section on true ecliptic motion.

sentences.zh: 得太陰黃道經度。

translations.literal: Obtain moon ecliptic longitude.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the moon's ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 求緯度，詳月離。

translations.literal: To find latitude, see lunar distance section.
translations.idiomatic: To find the latitude, see the section on lunar distance.

sentences.zh: 求太陰赤道經緯度，詳月離求太陰出入時刻條。

translations.literal: To find moon equatorial longitude and latitude, see lunar distance section on moon rise and set times.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's equatorial longitude and latitude, see the section on lunar distance concerning rising and setting times.

sentences.zh: 求宿度，同日躔。

translations.literal: To find lodge degree, same as solar motion section.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lodge position, use the same method as in the section on solar motion.

sentences.zh: 求黃道地平交角，以食甚時刻變赤道度，每時之四分變一度。

translations.literal: To find ecliptic-horizon angle: convert greatest-eclipse time to equatorial degrees, each quarter-hour converts to one degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic-horizon angle: convert the time of greatest eclipse to equatorial degrees, with each quarter-hour equal to one degree.

sentences.zh: 又於太陽赤道經度內減三宮，不及減者，加十二宮減之。

translations.literal: Further subtract three mansions from sun equatorial longitude; if insufficient to subtract, add twelve mansions then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract three mansions from the sun's equatorial longitude; if insufficient, add twelve mansions before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 餘為太陽距春分赤道度。

translations.literal: Remainder is sun's equatorial distance from spring equinox.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the sun's equatorial longitude measured from the spring equinox.

sentences.zh: 兩數相加，滿全周去之。

translations.literal: Add the two numbers, remove full circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Add the two values and cast out full circuits.

sentences.zh: 為春分距子正赤道度。

translations.literal: This is spring equinox's equatorial distance from exact zi.
translations.idiomatic: This gives the spring equinox's equatorial longitude from exact zi.

sentences.zh: 與半周相減，得春分距午正東西赤道度。

translations.literal: Subtract from semicircle, obtaining spring equinox's east-west equatorial distance from noon.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from a semicircle to obtain the spring equinox's east-west equatorial distance from noon.

sentences.zh: 過半周者，減去半周，為午正西。

translations.literal: If exceeding semicircle, subtract semicircle, as west of noon.
translations.idiomatic: If it exceeds a semicircle, subtract the semicircle to place it west of noon.

sentences.zh: 不及半周者，去減半周，為午正東。

translations.literal: If insufficient for semicircle, subtract from semicircle, as east of noon.
translations.idiomatic: If it falls short of a semicircle, subtract it from the semicircle to place it east of noon.

sentences.zh: 春分距午正東西度過象限者，與半周相減，餘為秋分距午正東西赤道度。

translations.literal: If spring equinox east-west distance from noon exceeds quadrant, subtract from semicircle, remainder is autumn equinox east-west equatorial distance from noon.
translations.idiomatic: If the spring equinox's east-west distance from noon exceeds a quadrant, subtract from a semicircle; the remainder is the autumn equinox's east-west equatorial distance from noon.

sentences.zh: 秋分距午東西，與春分相反。

translations.literal: Autumn equinox east-west from noon is opposite to spring equinox.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn equinox's east-west relation to noon is the reverse of the spring equinox.

sentences.zh: 以春秋分距午正東西度與九十度相減，餘為春秋分距地平赤道度。

translations.literal: Subtract equinox east-west distance from noon from ninety degrees, remainder is equinox equatorial distance from horizon.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the equinox's east-west distance from noon from ninety degrees; the remainder is the equinox's equatorial distance from the horizon.

sentences.zh: 乃用為弧三角形之一邊，以黃赤大距及赤道地平交角即赤道地平上高度，春分午西、秋分午東者用此。

translations.literal: Use as one side of spherical triangle, with great ecliptic-equator distance and equator-horizon angle, i.e. equatorial altitude above horizon; use this when spring equinox is west of noon or autumn equinox east of noon.
translations.idiomatic: Use this as one side of a spherical triangle, with the obliquity of the ecliptic and the equator-horizon angle (the equatorial altitude); apply when the spring equinox lies west of noon or the autumn equinox east of noon.

sentences.zh: 若春分午東、秋分午西者，則以此度與半周相減用其餘。

translations.literal: If spring equinox east of noon or autumn equinox west of noon, subtract this degree from semicircle and use the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: If the spring equinox lies east of noon or the autumn equinox west of noon, subtract this value from a semicircle and use the remainder.

sentences.zh: 為邊傍之兩角，求得對邊之角，為黃道地平交角。

translations.literal: As the two adjacent angles, obtain the angle opposite the side, as ecliptic-horizon angle.
translations.idiomatic: With these as the two adjacent angles, solve for the opposite angle to obtain the ecliptic-horizon angle.

sentences.zh: 春分午東、秋分午西者，得數即為黃道地平交角。

translations.literal: When spring equinox east of noon or autumn equinox west of noon, the number obtained is the ecliptic-horizon angle.
translations.idiomatic: When the spring equinox is east of noon or the autumn equinox west of noon, the result is the ecliptic-horizon angle directly.

sentences.zh: 春分午西、秋分午東者，則以得數與半周相減，餘為黃道地平交角。

translations.literal: When spring equinox west of noon or autumn equinox east of noon, subtract result from semicircle, remainder is ecliptic-horizon angle.
translations.idiomatic: When the spring equinox is west of noon or the autumn equinox east of noon, subtract the result from a semicircle; the remainder is the ecliptic-horizon angle.

sentences.zh: 求黃道高弧交角，以黃道地平交角之正弦為一率，赤道地平交角之正弦為二率，春秋分距地平赤道度之正弦為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得春秋分距地平黃道度。

translations.literal: To find ecliptic altitude arc angle: sine of ecliptic-horizon angle as first ratio, sine of equator-horizon angle as second, sine of equinox equatorial distance from horizon as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for equinox ecliptic distance from horizon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic altitude arc angle: use the sines of the ecliptic-horizon angle, the equator-horizon angle, and the equinox's equatorial distance from the horizon; look up the result to obtain the equinox's ecliptic distance from the horizon.

sentences.zh: 又視春秋分在地平上者，以太陰黃道經度與三宮、九宮相減，春分與三宮相減，秋分與九宮相減。

translations.literal: Further, viewing equinox on horizon: subtract moon ecliptic longitude from third or ninth mansion; spring equinox subtract third mansion, autumn equinox subtract ninth.
translations.idiomatic: When the equinox is on the horizon, subtract the moon's ecliptic longitude from the third or ninth mansion: subtract the third mansion at spring equinox and the ninth at autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 餘為太陰距春秋分黃道度。

translations.literal: Remainder is moon's ecliptic distance from equinox.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the moon's ecliptic longitude measured from the equinox.

sentences.zh: 春秋分宮度大於太陰宮度，為距春秋分前；

translations.literal: If equinox mansion degree greater than moon mansion degree, it is before the equinox;
translations.idiomatic: If the equinox mansion longitude exceeds the moon's mansion longitude, the moon lies before the equinox;

sentences.zh: 反此則在後。

translations.literal: otherwise it is after.
translations.idiomatic: otherwise it lies after.

sentences.zh: 又以春秋分距地平黃道度與太陰距春秋分黃道度相加減，為太陰距地平黃道度，春秋分在午正西者，太陰在分後則加，在分前則減；

translations.literal: Further add or subtract equinox ecliptic distance from horizon with moon's distance from equinox, as moon's ecliptic distance from horizon; when equinox west of noon, moon after equinox then add, before then subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Combine the equinox's ecliptic distance from the horizon with the moon's distance from the equinox to obtain the moon's ecliptic distance from the horizon; when the equinox is west of noon, add if the moon is after the equinox and subtract if before;

sentences.zh: 春秋分在午正東者反是。

translations.literal: when equinox east of noon, the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: when the equinox is east of noon, reverse the rule.

sentences.zh: 隨視其距限之東西。

translations.literal: Follow whether its distance limit is east or west.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust according to whether the eclipse limit lies to the east or west.

sentences.zh: 春秋分在午正西者，太陰距地平黃道度不及九十度為限西，過九十度為限東；

translations.literal: When equinox west of noon, moon ecliptic distance from horizon under ninety degrees is limit west, over ninety degrees is limit east;
translations.idiomatic: When the equinox is west of noon, if the moon's ecliptic distance from the horizon is less than ninety degrees the limit is west; if greater, east;

sentences.zh: 春秋分在午正東者反是。

translations.literal: when equinox east of noon, the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: when the equinox is east of noon, reverse the rule.

sentences.zh: 乃以太陰距地平黃道度之餘弦為一率，本天半徑為二率，黃道地平交角之餘切為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得黃道高弧交角。

translations.literal: Then cosine of moon ecliptic distance from horizon as first ratio, celestial radius as second, cotangent of ecliptic-horizon angle as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for ecliptic altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: Use the cosine of the moon's ecliptic distance from the horizon, the celestial radius, and the cotangent of the ecliptic-horizon angle; look up the resulting tangent to obtain the ecliptic altitude arc angle.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓定交角，置食甚交周，以初虧、復圓距弧加減之，得初虧、復圓交周。

translations.literal: To find fixed contact angles for first and last contact: set greatest-eclipse nodal longitude, add or subtract first/last contact interval arcs, obtaining first/last contact nodal longitudes.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed contact angles: take the nodal longitude at greatest eclipse and add or subtract the contact interval arcs to obtain the nodal longitudes at first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 減得初虧，加得復圓。

translations.literal: Subtract for first contact, add for last contact.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for first contact; add for last contact.

sentences.zh: 乃以本天半徑為一率，黃白大距之正弦為二率，初虧交周之正弦為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得初虧距緯。

translations.literal: Then celestial radius as first ratio, sine of great ecliptic-lunar distance as second, sine of first-contact nodal longitude as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for first-contact latitude distance.
translations.idiomatic: Use the celestial radius, the sine of the great ecliptic-lunar distance, and the sine of the nodal longitude at first contact; look up the result to obtain the latitude distance at first contact.

sentences.zh: 又以復圓交周之正弦為三率，一率二率同前。

translations.literal: Further use sine of last-contact nodal longitude as third ratio, first and second ratios as before.
translations.idiomatic: Use the sine of the nodal longitude at last contact as the third ratio, with the first and second unchanged.

sentences.zh: 求得四率為正弦，檢表得復圓距緯。

translations.literal: Fourth ratio is sine, look up table for last-contact latitude distance.
translations.idiomatic: Look up the resulting sine to obtain the latitude distance at last contact.

sentences.zh: 交周初宮、五宮為緯北，六宮、十一宮為緯南。

translations.literal: Nodal longitude in first or fifth mansion is north latitude, sixth or eleventh mansion is south latitude.
translations.idiomatic: If the nodal longitude is in the first or fifth mansion, latitude is north; if in the sixth or eleventh, south.

sentences.zh: 又以並徑之正弦為一率，初虧、復圓距緯之正弦各為二率，半徑千萬為三率，各求得四率為正弦，檢表得初虧、復圓兩緯差角。

translations.literal: Further sine of combined diameter as first ratio, sines of first/last contact latitude distances each as second, radius ten million as third, each fourth ratio is sine, look up table for two latitude-difference angles at first and last contact.
translations.idiomatic: Use the sine of the combined diameter and the sines of the latitude distances at first and last contact, with the radius of ten million; look up the two latitude-difference angles.

sentences.zh: 以兩緯差角各與黃道高弧交角相加減，得初虧、復圓定交角。

translations.literal: Add or subtract each latitude-difference angle with ecliptic altitude arc angle, obtaining fixed contact angles for first and last contact.
translations.idiomatic: Combine each latitude-difference angle with the ecliptic altitude arc angle to obtain the fixed contact angles.

sentences.zh: 初虧限東，緯南則加，緯北則減；

translations.literal: First contact, limit east: south latitude add, north latitude subtract;
translations.idiomatic: At first contact in the eastern limit: add for south latitude, subtract for north;

sentences.zh: 限西，緯南則減，緯北則加。

translations.literal: limit west: south latitude subtract, north latitude add.
translations.idiomatic: in the western limit: subtract for south latitude, add for north.

sentences.zh: 復圓反是。

translations.literal: Last contact is the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: For last contact, reverse the rule.

sentences.zh: 若初虧、復圓無緯差角，即以黃道高弧交角為定交角。

translations.literal: If first and last contact have no latitude-difference angle, use ecliptic altitude arc angle directly as fixed contact angle.
translations.idiomatic: If there is no latitude-difference angle at contact, use the ecliptic altitude arc angle directly as the fixed contact angle.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓方位，食在限東者，定交角在四十五度以內，初虧下偏左，復圓上偏右。

translations.literal: To find first/last contact orientation: eclipse in eastern limit, fixed angle within forty-five degrees, first contact lower-left bias, last contact upper-right bias.
translations.idiomatic: To find the orientation at first and last contact: when the eclipse is in the eastern limit and the fixed angle is within forty-five degrees, first contact lies lower-left and last contact upper-right.

sentences.zh: 四十五度以外，初虧左偏下，復圓右偏上。

translations.literal: Beyond forty-five degrees, first contact left-lower bias, last contact right-upper bias.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond forty-five degrees, first contact is to the lower left and last contact to the upper right.

sentences.zh: 適足九十度，初虧正左，復圓正右。

translations.literal: Exactly ninety degrees, first contact directly left, last contact directly right.
translations.idiomatic: At exactly ninety degrees, first contact is directly to the left and last contact directly to the right.

sentences.zh: 過九十度，初虧左偏上，復圓右偏下。

translations.literal: Past ninety degrees, first contact left-upper bias, last contact right-lower bias.
translations.idiomatic: Past ninety degrees, first contact is to the upper left and last contact to the lower right.

sentences.zh: 食在限西者，定交角四十五度以內，初虧上偏左，復圓下偏右。

translations.literal: Eclipse in western limit, fixed angle within forty-five degrees, first contact upper-left bias, last contact lower-right bias.
translations.idiomatic: When the eclipse is in the western limit and the fixed angle is within forty-five degrees, first contact lies upper-left and last contact lower-right.

sentences.zh: 四十五度以外，初虧左偏上，復圓右偏下。

translations.literal: Beyond forty-five degrees, first contact left-upper bias, last contact right-lower bias.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond forty-five degrees, first contact is to the upper left and last contact to the lower right.

sentences.zh: 適足九十度，初虧正左，復圓正右。

translations.literal: Exactly ninety degrees, first contact directly left, last contact directly right.
translations.idiomatic: At exactly ninety degrees, first contact is directly to the left and last contact directly to the right.

sentences.zh: 過九十度，初虧左偏下，復圓右偏上。

translations.literal: Past ninety degrees, first contact left-lower bias, last contact right-upper bias.
translations.idiomatic: Past ninety degrees, first contact is to the lower left and last contact to the upper right.

sentences.zh: 京師黃平象限恆在天頂南，定方位如此。

translations.literal: At the capital the ecliptic-horizon quadrant is always south of the zenith; fix orientation accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital, the ecliptic-horizon quadrant always lies south of the zenith; determine orientation accordingly.

sentences.zh: 在天頂北反是。

translations.literal: If north of zenith, the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: If the quadrant lies north of the zenith, reverse the orientation.

sentences.zh: 求帶食分秒，以本日日出或日入時分初虧或食甚在日入前者，為帶食出地，用日入分。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse magnitude: using this day's sunrise or sunset time, if first contact or greatest eclipse is before sunset, it is horizon eclipse at emergence, use sunset time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the magnitude of a horizon eclipse: if first contact or greatest eclipse occurs before sunset, it is an eclipse emerging from the horizon—use the sunset time.

sentences.zh: 食甚或復圓在日出後者，為帶食入地，用日出分。

translations.literal: If greatest eclipse or last contact is after sunrise, it is horizon eclipse at setting, use sunrise time.
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse or last contact occurs after sunrise, it is an eclipse setting below the horizon—use the sunrise time.

sentences.zh: 與食甚時分相減，餘為帶食距時。

translations.literal: Subtract from greatest-eclipse time, remainder is horizon-eclipse interval time.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the time of greatest eclipse; the remainder is the interval time to the horizon.

sentences.zh: 以一小時化秒為一率，一小時月距日實行化秒為二率，帶食距時化秒為三率，求得四率為秒。

translations.literal: One hour in seconds as first ratio, hourly moon-sun true motion in seconds as second, horizon-eclipse interval time in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Use one hour in seconds, the hourly true moon-sun elongation in seconds, and the horizon interval time in seconds; the fourth ratio gives the correction in seconds.

sentences.zh: 以度分收之，為帶食距弧。

translations.literal: Reduce to degrees and minutes, as horizon-eclipse interval arc.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to degrees and minutes to obtain the horizon interval arc.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑千萬為一率，帶食距弧之餘切為二率，食甚距緯之餘弦為三率，求得四率為餘切，檢表得帶食兩心相距之弧。

translations.literal: Further radius ten million as first ratio, cotangent of horizon-eclipse interval arc as second, cosine of greatest-eclipse latitude distance as third, fourth ratio is cotangent, look up table for arc between two centers at horizon eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Use the radius of ten million, the cotangent of the horizon interval arc, and the cosine of the latitude at greatest eclipse; look up the arc between the two centers at the horizon.

sentences.zh: 乃以太陰全徑為一率，十分為二率，並徑內減帶食兩心相距之餘為三率，求得四率，即帶食分秒。

translations.literal: Then moon full diameter as first ratio, ten as second, within combined diameter subtract remainder of two-center distance as third, fourth ratio is horizon-eclipse magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: Use the moon's full diameter and ten as ratios; subtract the center separation from the combined diameter as the third ratio; the fourth ratio is the horizon eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求各省月食時刻，以各省距京師東西偏度變時，每偏一度，變時之四分。

translations.literal: To find provincial lunar-eclipse times: convert by each province's east-west offset from capital, each degree of offset converts to one quarter-hour.
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar eclipse times for each province: convert by the province's longitudinal offset from the capital, with each degree equal to one quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 加減京師月食時刻，即得。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from capital lunar-eclipse time, and it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this from the capital's eclipse time to obtain the provincial time.

sentences.zh: 東加，西減。

translations.literal: East add, west subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add for provinces to the east; subtract for those to the west.

sentences.zh: 求各省月食方位，以各省赤道高度及月食時刻，依京師推方位法求之，即得。

translations.literal: To find provincial lunar-eclipse orientation: using each province's equatorial altitude and eclipse time, follow capital's orientation method, and it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse orientation for each province: use the provincial equatorial altitude and eclipse time, applying the same orientation method as for the capital.

sentences.zh: 繪月食圖，先作橫豎二線，直角相交，橫線當黃道，豎線當黃道經圈，用地影半徑度於中心作圈以象闇虛。

translations.literal: To draw lunar-eclipse diagram: first draw horizontal and vertical lines intersecting at right angle; horizontal line represents ecliptic, vertical represents ecliptic meridian; at center draw circle with Earth-shadow semidiameter to represent the shadow cone.
translations.idiomatic: To draw the lunar eclipse diagram: first draw horizontal and vertical lines at right angles—the horizontal for the ecliptic, the vertical for the ecliptic meridian—and at the center draw a circle with the Earth's shadow semidiameter to represent the umbra.

sentences.zh: 次以並徑為度作外虛圈，為初虧、復圓之限。

translations.literal: Next with combined diameter as measure draw outer shadow circle, as limit for first and last contact.
translations.idiomatic: Next draw an outer circle with the combined diameter as the limit for first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 又以兩徑較為度作內虛圈，為食既、生光之限。

translations.literal: Further with two-semidiameter difference as measure draw inner shadow circle, as limit for totality and light return.
translations.idiomatic: Draw an inner circle with the difference of the two semidiameters as the limit for totality and the return of light.

sentences.zh: 復於外虛圈上周豎線或左或右，取五度為識，視實交周初宮、十一宮作識於右，五宮、六宮作識於左。

translations.literal: Further on outer circle along vertical line left or right, take five degrees as mark; viewing true nodal longitude in first or eleventh mansion place mark on right, fifth or sixth mansion on left.
translations.idiomatic: On the outer circle along the vertical line, mark five degrees to the left or right: if the true nodal longitude is in the first or eleventh mansion, mark on the right; if in the fifth or sixth, on the left.

sentences.zh: 乃自所識作線過圈心至外虛圈下周，即為白道經圈。

translations.literal: Then from the mark draw line through circle center to lower part of outer circle, which is the lunar-path meridian.
translations.idiomatic: Draw a line from the mark through the center to the lower edge of the outer circle; this is the lunar-path meridian.

sentences.zh: 於此線上自圈心取食甚距緯作識，即食甚月心所在。

translations.literal: On this line from center take greatest-eclipse latitude distance as mark, which is the moon's center at greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Along this line from the center, mark the latitude distance at greatest eclipse to locate the moon's center at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 從此作十字橫線，即為白道。

translations.literal: From this draw cross horizontal line, which is the lunar path.
translations.idiomatic: From this point draw a horizontal cross-line representing the lunar path.

sentences.zh: 割內外虛圈之點，為食甚前後四限月心所在。

translations.literal: Points cutting inner and outer shadow circles are locations of moon's center at the four limits before and after greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: The points where the lunar path cuts the inner and outer circles mark the moon's center at the four contact phases before and after greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 末以月半徑為度，於五限月心各作小圈，五限之象具備。

translations.literal: Finally with moon semidiameter as measure, at each of the five limit moon-centers draw small circles; the five phases are complete.
translations.idiomatic: Finally draw small circles at each of the five moon-center positions using the lunar semidiameter; the five phases of the eclipse are now complete.

sentences.zh: 日食用數

translations.literal: Constants used for solar eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Constants for solar eclipse calculation

sentences.zh: 太陽實半徑五百零七，餘見月食推日食法。

translations.literal: Sun true semidiameter 507; remainder see lunar-eclipse section on computing solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Solar true semidiameter: 507; for the remaining constants and methods, see the lunar-eclipse section on computing solar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求天正冬至，同日躔。

translations.literal: To find civil-year winter solstice, same as solar motion section.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the civil year, use the same method as in the section on solar motion.

sentences.zh: 求紀日，同月食。

translations.literal: To find cycle days, same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the cycle-day count, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求首朔，同月食。

translations.literal: To find epoch new moon, same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the epoch new moon, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求太陰入食限，與月食求逐月望平交周之法同，惟不用望策，即為逐月朔平交周。

translations.literal: To find moon entering eclipse limit, same as lunar-eclipse method for each month's full-moon mean nodal longitude, only without full-moon interval, thus each month's new-moon mean nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: To determine whether the moon enters the eclipse zone, use the same method as for finding each month's mean nodal longitude at full moon in the lunar-eclipse section, but without the half-month interval—this gives the mean nodal longitude at each new moon.

sentences.zh: 視某月交周入可食之限，即為有食之月。

translations.literal: If a given month's nodal longitude enters possible-eclipse limit, that month may have an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If a given month's nodal longitude falls within the possible-eclipse zone, that month may witness a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交周自五宮九度零八分至六宮八度五十一分，又自十一宮二十一度零九分至初宮二十度五十二分，皆為可食之限。

translations.literal: Nodal longitude from fifth mansion 9°08′ to sixth mansion 8°51′, and from eleventh mansion 21°09′ to first mansion 20°52′, are all possible-eclipse limits.
translations.idiomatic: The possible-eclipse zone runs from 9°08′ in the fifth mansion to 8°51′ in the sixth, and from 21°09′ in the eleventh mansion to 20°52′ in the first.

sentences.zh: 求平朔，

translations.literal: To find mean new moon,
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean new moon,

sentences.zh: 求太陽平行，

translations.literal: To find sun mean motion,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's mean longitude,

sentences.zh: 求太陽平引，

translations.literal: To find sun mean anomaly,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's mean equation,

sentences.zh: 求太陰平引，以上四條，皆與月食求平望之法同，惟不加望策。

translations.literal: To find moon mean anomaly; the above four items all follow lunar-eclipse method for mean full moon, only without adding full-moon interval.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's mean anomaly—the above four steps all follow the lunar-eclipse method for mean full moon, but without adding the half-month interval.

sentences.zh: 求太陽實引，同月食。

translations.literal: To find sun true anomaly, same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's true anomaly, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求太陰實引，同月食。

translations.literal: To find moon true anomaly, same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's true anomaly, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求實朔，與月食求實望之法同。

translations.literal: To find true new moon, same as lunar-eclipse method for true full moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true new moon, use the same method as for finding the true full moon in the lunar-eclipse section.

sentences.zh: 求實交周，與月食同。

translations.literal: To find true nodal longitude, same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true nodal longitude, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 視實交周入食限為有食。

translations.literal: If true nodal longitude enters eclipse limit, there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If the true nodal longitude falls within the eclipse zone, an eclipse will occur.

sentences.zh: 自五宮十一度四十五分至六宮六度十四分，又自十一宮二十三度四十六分至初宮十八度十五分，為實朔可食限。

translations.literal: From fifth mansion 11°45′ to sixth mansion 6°14′, and from eleventh mansion 23°46′ to first mansion 18°15′, are true-new-moon possible-eclipse limits.
translations.idiomatic: The possible-eclipse zone at true new moon runs from 11°45′ in the fifth mansion to 6°14′ in the sixth, and from 23°46′ in the eleventh mansion to 18°15′ in the first.

sentences.zh: 求太陽黃赤道實經度，同月食。

translations.literal: To find sun true ecliptic and equatorial longitude, same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's true ecliptic and equatorial longitude, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求實朔用時，同月食求實望用時。

translations.literal: To find true-new-moon apparent time, same as lunar-eclipse method for true-full-moon apparent time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent time of true new moon, use the same method as for the apparent time of true full moon in the lunar-eclipse section.

sentences.zh: 實朔用時，在日出前或日入後。

translations.literal: True-new-moon apparent time must be before sunrise or after sunset.
translations.idiomatic: The apparent time of true new moon must fall before sunrise or after sunset.

sentences.zh: 五刻以外，則在夜，不必算。

translations.literal: Beyond five quarters, it is at night, need not calculate.
translations.idiomatic: If it lies more than five quarters of an hour from sunrise or sunset, the event falls at night and need not be calculated.

sentences.zh: 求食甚用時，與月食求食甚時刻法同。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse apparent time, same as lunar-eclipse method for greatest-eclipse time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent time of greatest eclipse, use the same method as in the lunar-eclipse section.

sentences.zh: 求用時春秋分距午赤道度，以太陽赤道經度減三宮，不足減者，加十二宮減之。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time equinox east-west equatorial distance from noon: subtract three mansions from sun equatorial longitude; if insufficient, add twelve mansions then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the equinox's east-west equatorial distance from noon at apparent time: subtract three mansions from the sun's equatorial longitude; if insufficient, add twelve mansions before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 為太陽距春分後赤道度。

translations.literal: This is sun's equatorial longitude after spring equinox.
translations.idiomatic: This gives the sun's equatorial longitude measured from the spring equinox.

sentences.zh: 又以食甚用時變為赤道度，加減半周，過半周者減去半周，不及半周者加半周。

translations.literal: Further convert greatest-eclipse apparent time to equatorial degrees, add or subtract semicircle; if exceeding semicircle subtract semicircle, if insufficient add semicircle.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the apparent time of greatest eclipse to equatorial degrees and add or subtract a semicircle; if it exceeds a semicircle, subtract one; if insufficient, add one.

sentences.zh: 為太陽距午正赤道度。

translations.literal: This is sun's equatorial distance from noon.
translations.idiomatic: This gives the sun's equatorial longitude measured from noon.

sentences.zh: 兩數相加，滿全周去之。

translations.literal: Add the two numbers, remove full circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Add the two values and cast out full circuits.

sentences.zh: 其數不過象限者，為春分距午西赤道度。

translations.literal: If the number does not exceed a quadrant, it is spring equinox's equatorial distance west of noon.
translations.idiomatic: If the result does not exceed a quadrant, it is the spring equinox's equatorial distance west of noon.

sentences.zh: 過一象限者，與半周相減，餘為秋分距午東赤道度。

translations.literal: If past one quadrant, subtract from semicircle, remainder is autumn equinox east of noon equatorial distance.
translations.idiomatic: If past one quadrant, subtract from a semicircle; the remainder is the autumn equinox's equatorial distance east of noon.

sentences.zh: 過二象限者，則減去二象限，餘為秋分距午西赤道度。

translations.literal: If past two quadrants, subtract two quadrants, remainder is autumn equinox west of noon equatorial distance.
translations.idiomatic: If past two quadrants, subtract two quadrants; the remainder is the autumn equinox's equatorial distance west of noon.

sentences.zh: 過三象限者，與全周相減，餘為春分距午東赤道度。

translations.literal: If past three quadrants, subtract from full circuit, remainder is spring equinox east of noon equatorial distance.
translations.idiomatic: If past three quadrants, subtract from the full circuit; the remainder is the spring equinox's equatorial distance east of noon.

sentences.zh: 求用時春秋分距午黃道度，以黃赤大距之餘弦為一率，本天半徑為二率，春秋分距午赤道度之正切為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得用時春秋分距午黃道度。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time equinox ecliptic distance from noon: cosine of obliquity as first ratio, celestial radius as second, tangent of equinox equatorial distance from noon as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for apparent-time equinox ecliptic distance from noon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the equinox's ecliptic distance from noon at apparent time: use the cosine of the obliquity, the celestial radius, and the tangent of the equatorial distance; look up the result in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求用時正午黃赤距緯，以本天半徑為一率，黃赤大距之正弦為二率，距午黃道度之正弦為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得用時正午黃赤距緯。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time noon ecliptic-equator latitude distance: celestial radius as first ratio, sine of obliquity as second, sine of ecliptic distance from noon as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for apparent-time noon ecliptic-equator latitude distance.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic-equator latitude separation at noon for apparent time: use the celestial radius, the sine of the obliquity, and the sine of the ecliptic distance from noon; look up the result in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求用時黃道與子午圈交角，以距午黃道度之正弦為一率，距午赤道度之正弦為二率，本天半徑為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得用時黃道與子午圈交角。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time ecliptic-meridian angle: sine of ecliptic distance from noon as first ratio, sine of equatorial distance from noon as second, celestial radius as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for apparent-time ecliptic-meridian angle.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle between the ecliptic and the meridian at apparent time: use the sines of the ecliptic and equatorial distances from noon and the celestial radius; look up the result in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求用時正午黃道宮度，置用時春秋分距午黃道度，春分加減三宮。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time noon ecliptic mansion degree: set apparent-time equinox ecliptic distance from noon; at spring equinox add or subtract three mansions.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic mansion at noon for apparent time: take the equinox's ecliptic distance from noon and, at spring equinox, add or subtract three mansions.

sentences.zh: 午西加三宮，午東與三宮相減。

translations.literal: West of noon add three mansions, east of noon subtract from three mansions.
translations.idiomatic: If west of noon, add three mansions; if east of noon, subtract from three mansions.

sentences.zh: 秋分加減九宮，午西加九宮，午東與九宮相減。

translations.literal: At autumn equinox add or subtract nine mansions; west of noon add nine mansions, east of noon subtract from nine mansions.
translations.idiomatic: At autumn equinox, add or subtract nine mansions; if west of noon, add nine; if east of noon, subtract from nine.

sentences.zh: 得用時正午黃道宮度。

translations.literal: Obtain apparent-time noon ecliptic mansion degree.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the ecliptic mansion at noon for apparent time.

sentences.zh: 求用時正午黃道高，置赤道高度，北極高度減象限之餘。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time noon ecliptic altitude: set equatorial altitude, remainder of north polar altitude minus quadrant.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic altitude at noon for apparent time: set the equatorial altitude to the north polar altitude minus a quadrant.

sentences.zh: 以正午黃赤距緯加減之，黃道三宮至八宮加，九宮至二宮減。

translations.literal: Add or subtract noon ecliptic-equator latitude distance; ecliptic mansions three through eight add, nine through two subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the noon ecliptic-equator latitude separation: add for mansions three through eight, subtract for nine through two.

sentences.zh: 即得。

translations.literal: And it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the result.

sentences.zh: 求用時黃平象限距午，以黃道子午圈交角之餘弦為一率，本天半徑為二率，正午黃道高之正切為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得度分。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time ecliptic-horizon quadrant distance from noon: cosine of ecliptic-meridian angle as first ratio, celestial radius as second, tangent of noon ecliptic altitude as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic-horizon quadrant's distance from noon at apparent time: use the cosine of the ecliptic-meridian angle, the celestial radius, and the tangent of the noon ecliptic altitude; look up the degrees and minutes in the tables.

sentences.zh: 與九十度相減，餘為黃平象限距午之度分。

translations.literal: Subtract from ninety degrees, remainder is ecliptic-horizon quadrant distance from noon in degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from ninety degrees; the remainder is the quadrant's distance from noon.

sentences.zh: 求用時黃平象限宮度，以黃平象限距午度分與正午黃道宮度相加減，正午黃道宮度初宮至五宮為加，六宮至十一宮為減，若正午黃道高過九十度，則反其加減。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time ecliptic-horizon quadrant mansion degree: add or subtract quadrant distance from noon with noon ecliptic mansion; mansions one through five add, six through eleven subtract; if noon ecliptic altitude exceeds ninety degrees, reverse addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: To find the quadrant mansion at apparent time: combine the quadrant distance from noon with the noon ecliptic mansion—add for mansions one through five, subtract for six through eleven; if noon ecliptic altitude exceeds ninety degrees, reverse the signs.

sentences.zh: 即得。

translations.literal: And it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the result.

sentences.zh: 求用時月距限，以太陽黃道經度與用時黃平象限宮度相減，餘為月距限度，隨視其距限之東西。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time moon distance from limit: subtract sun ecliptic longitude from apparent-time ecliptic-horizon quadrant mansion degree, remainder is moon distance from limit; follow whether limit is east or west.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's distance from the eclipse limit at apparent time: subtract the quadrant mansion from the sun's ecliptic longitude; adjust according to whether the limit lies east or west.

sentences.zh: 太陽黃道經度大於黃平象限宮度者為限東，小者為限西。

translations.literal: If sun ecliptic longitude greater than ecliptic-horizon quadrant mansion degree, limit is east; if smaller, limit is west.
translations.idiomatic: If the sun's ecliptic longitude exceeds the quadrant mansion, the limit is east; if less, west.

sentences.zh: 求用時限距地高，以本天半徑為一率，黃道子午圈交角之正弦為二率，正午黃道高之餘弦為三率，求得四率為餘弦，檢表得限距地高。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time limit altitude above horizon: celestial radius as first ratio, sine of ecliptic-meridian angle as second, cosine of noon ecliptic altitude as third, fourth ratio is cosine, look up table for limit altitude above horizon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the limit's altitude above the horizon at apparent time: use the celestial radius, the sine of the ecliptic-meridian angle, and the cosine of the noon ecliptic altitude; look up the result in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求用時太陰高弧，以本天半徑為一率，限距地高之正弦為二率，月距限之餘弦為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得太陰高弧。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time moon altitude arc: celestial radius as first ratio, sine of limit altitude as second, cosine of moon distance from limit as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for moon altitude arc.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's altitude arc at apparent time: use the celestial radius, the sine of the limit altitude, and the cosine of the moon's distance from the limit; look up the result in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求用時黃道高弧交角，以月距限之正弦為一率，限距地高之餘切為二率，本天半徑為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得黃道高弧交角。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time ecliptic altitude arc angle: sine of moon distance from limit as first ratio, cotangent of limit altitude as second, celestial radius as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for ecliptic altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic altitude arc angle at apparent time: use the sine of the moon's distance from the limit, the cotangent of the limit altitude, and the celestial radius; look up the result in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求用時白道高弧交角，置黃道高弧交角，以黃白大距加減之，食甚交周初宮、十一宮，月距限東則加，限西則減。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time lunar-path altitude arc angle: set ecliptic altitude arc angle, add or subtract great ecliptic-lunar distance; at greatest eclipse nodal longitude in first or eleventh mansion, moon limit east then add, west then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar-path altitude arc angle at apparent time: take the ecliptic altitude arc angle and add or subtract the great ecliptic-lunar distance; if the nodal longitude at greatest eclipse is in the first or eleventh mansion, add when the limit is east and subtract when west.

sentences.zh: 五宮、六宮反是。

translations.literal: Fifth and sixth mansions, the reverse.
translations.idiomatic: For the fifth and sixth mansions, reverse the rule.

sentences.zh: 即得。

translations.literal: And it is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the result.

sentences.zh: 如過九十度，限東變為限西，限西變為限東，不足減者反減之。

translations.literal: If past ninety degrees, limit east becomes limit west, limit west becomes limit east; if insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: If the angle exceeds ninety degrees, east and west limits interchange; if subtraction is insufficient, reverse it.

sentences.zh: 則黃平象限在天頂南者，白平象限在天頂北；

translations.literal: Then if ecliptic-horizon quadrant is south of zenith, lunar-path horizon quadrant is north of zenith;
translations.idiomatic: If the ecliptic-horizon quadrant lies south of the zenith, the lunar-path horizon quadrant lies north;

sentences.zh: 黃平象限在天頂北者，白平象限在天頂南。

translations.literal: if ecliptic-horizon quadrant is north of zenith, lunar-path horizon quadrant is south of zenith.
translations.idiomatic: if the ecliptic-horizon quadrant lies north of the zenith, the lunar-path horizon quadrant lies south.

sentences.zh: 求太陽距地，詳月食求地影半徑條。

translations.literal: To find sun distance from Earth, see lunar-eclipse section on Earth-shadow semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's distance from Earth, see the lunar-eclipse section on the Earth's shadow semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 求太陰距地，詳月食求太陰半徑條。

translations.literal: To find moon distance from Earth, see lunar-eclipse section on lunar semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's distance from Earth, see the lunar-eclipse section on the lunar semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 求用時高下差，用平三角形，以地半徑為一邊，太陽距地為一邊，用時太陰高弧與象限相減，餘為所夾之角，求得對太陽距地邊之角。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time parallax in altitude: use plane triangle, Earth semidiameter as one side, sun distance from Earth as one side, apparent-time moon altitude arc minus quadrant as included angle, obtain angle opposite sun-distance side.
translations.idiomatic: To find the parallax in altitude at apparent time: in a plane triangle with the Earth's semidiameter and the sun's distance as sides, use the moon's altitude arc minus a quadrant as the included angle and solve for the angle opposite the sun's distance.

sentences.zh: 減去一象限，為太陽視高。

translations.literal: Subtract one quadrant, as sun apparent altitude.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract a quadrant to obtain the sun's apparent altitude.

sentences.zh: 與太陰高弧相減，餘為太陽地半徑差。

translations.literal: Subtract from moon altitude arc, remainder is sun terrestrial-semidiameter parallax.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the moon's altitude arc; the remainder is the sun's parallax due to the Earth's semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 又用平三角形，以地半徑為一邊，太陰距地為一邊，用時太陰高弧與象限相減，餘為所夾之角，求得對太陰距地邊之角。

translations.literal: Again use plane triangle, Earth semidiameter as one side, moon distance as one side, apparent-time moon altitude arc minus quadrant as included angle, obtain angle opposite moon-distance side.
translations.idiomatic: Again in a plane triangle with the Earth's semidiameter and the moon's distance, use the moon's altitude arc minus a quadrant and solve for the angle opposite the moon's distance.

sentences.zh: 減去一象限，為太陰視高。

translations.literal: Subtract one quadrant, as moon apparent altitude.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract a quadrant to obtain the moon's apparent altitude.

sentences.zh: 與高弧相減，餘為太陰地半徑差。

translations.literal: Subtract from altitude arc, remainder is moon terrestrial-semidiameter parallax.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the altitude arc; the remainder is the moon's parallax due to the Earth's semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 兩地半徑差相減，得高下差。

translations.literal: Subtract the two terrestrial-semidiameter parallaxes, obtaining parallax in altitude.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two parallaxes to obtain the difference in altitude parallax.

sentences.zh: 求用時東西差，以半徑千萬為一率，白道高弧交角之餘弦為二率，高下差之正切為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得用時東西差。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time east-west difference: radius ten million as first ratio, cosine of lunar-path altitude arc angle as second, tangent of parallax in altitude as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for apparent-time east-west difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the east-west correction at apparent time: use the radius of ten million, the cosine of the lunar-path altitude arc angle, and the tangent of the altitude parallax; look up the result in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求食甚近時，以月距日實行化秒為一率，一小時化秒為二率，東西差化秒為三率，求得四率為秒。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse near time: moon-sun true motion in seconds as first ratio, one hour in seconds as second, east-west difference in seconds as third, fourth ratio in seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the near time of greatest eclipse: use the true moon-sun elongation in seconds, one hour in seconds, and the east-west correction in seconds; the fourth ratio gives the correction in seconds.

sentences.zh: 以時分收之，為近時距分。

translations.literal: Reduce to hours and minutes, as near-time interval fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to hours and minutes as the near-time interval.

sentences.zh: 以加減食甚用時，月距限西則加，限東則減，仍視白道高弧交角變限不變限為定。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from greatest-eclipse apparent time; moon limit west then add, east then subtract; still follow whether lunar-path altitude arc angle changes limit or not as determinant.
translations.idiomatic: Apply to the apparent time of greatest eclipse: add if the limit is west, subtract if east—still governed by whether the lunar-path altitude arc angle reverses the limit.

sentences.zh: 得食甚近時。

translations.literal: Obtain greatest-eclipse near time.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the near time of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求近時春秋分距午赤道度，以食甚近時變赤道度求之，餘與前用時之法同。

translations.literal: To find near-time equinox equatorial distance from noon: convert by greatest-eclipse near time to equatorial degrees; remainder same as previous apparent-time method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the equinox's equatorial distance from noon at near time: convert using the near time of greatest eclipse; the remaining steps follow the apparent-time method.

sentences.zh: 後諸條仿此，但皆用近時度分立算。

translations.literal: Following items imitate this, but all use near-time degrees separately in calculation.
translations.idiomatic: The following steps follow the same pattern, but all calculations use the near-time values.

sentences.zh: 求近時春秋分距午黃道度。

translations.literal: To find near-time equinox ecliptic distance from noon.
translations.idiomatic: Find the equinox's ecliptic distance from noon at near time.

sentences.zh: 求近時正午黃赤距緯。

translations.literal: To find near-time noon ecliptic-equator latitude distance.
translations.idiomatic: Find the noon ecliptic-equator latitude separation at near time.

sentences.zh: 求近時黃道與子午圈交角。

translations.literal: To find near-time ecliptic-meridian angle.
translations.idiomatic: Find the ecliptic-meridian angle at near time.

sentences.zh: 求近時正午黃道宮度。

translations.literal: To find near-time noon ecliptic mansion degree.
translations.idiomatic: Find the noon ecliptic mansion at near time.

sentences.zh: 求近時正午黃道高。

translations.literal: To find near-time noon ecliptic altitude.
translations.idiomatic: Find the noon ecliptic altitude at near time.

sentences.zh: 求近時黃平象限距午。

translations.literal: To find near-time ecliptic-horizon quadrant distance from noon.
translations.idiomatic: Find the ecliptic-horizon quadrant's distance from noon at near time.

sentences.zh: 求近時黃平象限宮度。

translations.literal: To find near-time ecliptic-horizon quadrant mansion degree.
translations.idiomatic: Find the ecliptic-horizon quadrant mansion at near time.

sentences.zh: 求近時月距限，置太陽黃道經度，加減用時東西差，依近時距分加減號。

translations.literal: To find near-time moon distance from limit: set sun ecliptic longitude, add or subtract apparent-time east-west difference, following near-time interval sign.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's distance from the limit at near time: take the sun's ecliptic longitude and add or subtract the apparent-time east-west correction according to the sign of the near-time interval.

sentences.zh: 為近時太陰黃道經度。

translations.literal: This is near-time moon ecliptic longitude.
